 By Chelsea Daniel October 29, 2026 Photo: Getty Images Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story No one does Halloween like Heidi Klum . For the past 25 years, the model and longtime television personality has thrown star-studded Halloween parties, using elaborate prosthetics to transform into everything from Jessica Rabbit to a worm. This year’s look is still top-secret, but she has dropped a few hints, including grotesque snapshots of innards and a backpack.
 “I try to always come up with something that no one has done before. I also always try to come up with something unexpected, or it’s a shape that maybe a human body doesn’t normally fit in,” Klum tells The Run-Through guest hosts Christian Allaire ( who has been covering Klum’s costumes for Vogue over the past six years ) and Margaux Anbouba.
 Also on the show, Chloe and Chioma catch up about the WNBA finals and their Halloween plans. Taking inspiration from Klum’s derring-do, Chloe’s whole family is Greeking out: while she will dress up as Medusa, her son and daughter will be Hades and Meg (from Hercules ), respectively. Plus, Chioma—or Dr. Nnadi—tells the story of receiving her honorary doctorate.
